_comment: Project spec for nix/corpus/build-sweep.py -- the BUILD half of the
external probe loop. Paths are relative to the corpus root passed on the
command line (a directory of upstream clones; see README.md). A project
whose directory is absent is skipped, so a partial corpus still sweeps.
`sources` is a directory whose *.c files each become one lib crate;
`includes` are added as -I. Files matching `skip` are not swept (test
harnesses, benchmarks, examples -- they are not library translation
units and their main()s pull in unrelated shapes).
